caption: The drawing shows a single black high-heeled boot with a pointed toe, depicted in a side profile on a light beige background. The boot has a high ankle and is fastened up the front with black laces threaded through a series of eyelets. There are decorative white and purple/pink stitching patterns along the edges and seams of the boot, particularly around the lace area, the top line, and the toe. The interior of the boot at the top is lined with a light purple/pink color. The heel is medium-high, block-shaped, and shown in black with a brown section on the inside edge. Above and to the left of the boot, there are two simplified outline sketches of the boot's sole seen from beneath and from above. The composition is centered on the boot with the sketches positioned in the upper left quadrant, and there are no other objects depicted.
title: Woman's Shoe
